responsibility: This source file contains selftests for GCC’s fibonacci_heap template rather than the heap algorithm itself. It exercises empty-heap behavior, insertion and extract-min order, key replacement, duplicate keys, heap union, shared pool allocation, and use of non-scalar key types, providing checking-mode validation of the container implementation in fibonacci_heap.h.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/fibonacci_heap.h, this .cc file does not implement heap operations; it is only a CHECKING_P selftest unit that exercises the fibonacci_heap template defined inline in the header.
